title: Pin technicians on Board View and the pins persist
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API: display List, no pinned technicians and no other Board View layout keys
At least four eligible technicians at this location, so the two chosen (A and B) do not start in the first two technician positions

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders and pick Board View from the display switcher
custom_steps_separated.expected: Board View loads, and neither A nor B is among the first two technician columns after Unassigned

custom_steps_separated.content: Pin technician A from its column header
custom_steps_separated.expected: A's pin shows as pressed (Unpin A), and A's column moves directly after Unassigned
B's column sits directly after A's, ahead of every unpinned technician

custom_steps_separated.content: Once the preference is saved, reload the page cold
custom_steps_separated.expected:
Board View reopens, A then B still sit directly after Unassigned, and both pins show as pressed

Pinned technicians sit right after Unassigned in the order they were pinned, and the pins are restored from the account after a reload
